title: May 2026: Slide generation, activity folders, multidimensional rubrics, and more!
summary: Our May 2026 updates, including slide generation, customizable videos, activity folders, multi-dimensional rubrics, images in documents, and updated AI models.
body_markdown: Sparky can now generate images and graphs directly inside documents. Ask for a diagram of the digestive system, a bar chart comparing data, or an illustration to bring a concept to life and it appears right where you need it. Visual learners get more engaging materials, and you spend less time hunting for the perfect clipart.[Learn more about document generation.](https://help.flintk12.com/en/articles/15002993-document-generation-in-flint)
